import urllib.request as ur
import urllib.error as ue
# Try the merritt.cdlib.org backend that Dryad uses
candidates = [
    'https://merritt.cdlib.org/d/ark%3A%2Fb5072%2Ffk2j10mc35',
    'https://merritt.cdlib.org/m/dryad_v2',
    'https://merritt.cdlib.org/object/ark:/b5072/fk2j10mc35',
    'https://merritt.cdlib.org/object/ark%3A%2Fb5072%2Ffk2j10mc35',
]
for url in candidates:
    req = ur.Request(url, method='GET', headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0', 'Accept': 'text/html,*/*'})
    try:
        with ur.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
            data = r.read(800)
            print(f'{r.status} {url}')
            print(f'  ct={r.headers.get("Content-Type")}, len={r.headers.get("Content-Length")}')
            print(f'  body[:200]={data[:200]!r}')
    except ue.HTTPError as e:
        print(f'{e.code} {url}: {e.reason}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'ERR {url}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
